Andres Quintero is a member of the Alum Rock Union School District school board in California. He assumed office in 2012. His current term ends on December 11, 2026.
Quintero is running for re-election to the Alum Rock Union School District school board to represent Trustee Area 3 in California. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026.
